newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kia Group shrs down on financial trouble rumours.
newsitem.headline: Kia Group shrs down on financial trouble rumours.

text.p: All six listed shares of Kia Group went limit down on Monday on market rumours that group affiliates faced financial problems, brokers said.
A group spokesman strongly denied the rumours.

Kia Motors Corp lost 1,200 won to 14,700 in early morning trading, Asia Motors 410 won to 4,740, Kia Steel 320 won to 3,680, Kia Service 650 won to 7,570, Kia Precision 640 won to 7,360 and Kisan 900 won to 11,200.

A Tongyang Securities broker said investors shied away from shares of the nation's eighth largest conglomerate or chaebol as its commercial vehicle manufacturer Asia Motors had had difficulties honouring its debt obligations on Monday.
Kia Motors hold a 29 percent stake in Asia Motors.
Korea First Bank, primary lender of Asia Motors, said the company had delayed on Monday paying back 130 billion won worth of promissory notes, owed mainly to merchant banks.
"Asia Motors finally honoured the debt obligations yesterday. So far, we see no problems in the company," said a Korea First Bank official.
"We had a temporary cash flow problem as other companies are experiencing. But we now have no financial trouble," said an Asia Motors spokesman Ahn Suk-woo.
Another Asia Motors official said several merchant banking corporations suddenly demanded repayment of debts on Monday.
But an official at a merchant banking corporation said the debts had been scheduled for repayment on Monday.
The Korea First Bank official said merchant banking corporations on Monday rolled over 840 billion won in debts for Asia Motors. ($1 = 890 won)
